source: loopback fixture HTTP only; external networking denied
scope: Default overlap workload with an actual concurrent identical fresh-creation retry; separate from the earlier timed monitor run

localResources.scope: Deno harness process after profile guard through fixture cleanup; excludes imports/startup and PostgreSQL/Edge processes

payloads.excludes: headers, TLS/TCP overhead, discovery responses, Realtime and hosted egress

cleanup: fixture identities removed; original policy/groups/slots/counters restored; ephemeral backend login dropped
limits: CPU/RSS belong to the local aggregate harness process, not an Edge invocation or the PostgreSQL server.
RSS is sampled every 100 ms, not an operating-system guaranteed peak.
Payload counts describe the small synthetic fixture responses and serialized saved DTOs, not representative live ESPN or hosted egress.
The earlier monitor timing evidence is preserved separately without a new timed run.
